recentItems.title: Hlengiwe Buthelezi to appear alongside co-accused Victor Majola on 18 September
recentItems.description:
Hlengiwe Buthelezi, the third suspect arrested in relation to the murder of Warrick 'DJ Warras' Stock will not be applying for bail.

Buthelezi made a brief appearance in the Johannesburg Magistrates Court, after police arrested her in Msinga in KwaZulu-Natal on Wednesday. 

She will now join her co-accused Victor Majola in court on 18 September.

Warras was gunned down in the Johannesburg CBD last year.

His killer Armando Pacula is already serving a 25-year sentence for the killing after pleading guilty, as SABC News senior reporter Chriselda Lewis reports.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Greater Tzaneen Municipality demolishes street hawkers' stalls along the R71 road near Duivelskloof
recentItems.description:
Some street hawkers along the R71 road near Duivelskloof outside Tzaneen say the Greater Tzaneen Municipality has demolished their stalls without eviction notices.  

They say that the stalls were their only source of income. 

One of the street hawkers, Matthews Ngoako has called on the municipality to lift red tapes against hawkers. 

For more on this we cross live to our reporter Avhaphani Munyai.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Residents question safety and quality of water in Hammanskraal
recentItems.description:
For years, residents of Hammanskraal, north of Pretoria, have battled unreliable water supplies, with ageing infrastructure and prolonged interruptions leaving many households dependent on water tankers and boreholes.

Despite several interventions and promises of a lasting solution, residents say they continue to struggle with dry taps and limited access to water.

For more on the water crisis and its impact on communities, we cross live to SABC News anchor Ayanda Nyathi in Hammanskraal, north of Pretoria.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Brown Mogotsi bail application continues
recentItems.description:
The State is expected to continue its cross-examination of North West businessman and alleged political fixer Brown Mogotsi in his bail application on new facts when the case resumes in the Johannesburg Magistrates court today.  

Mogotsi faces several charges including unlawful possession of a firearm and ammunition, discharging a firearm in a built-up area, defeating or obstructing the administration of justice, and perjury.

recentItems.title: Bafana Mahungela found guilty of all charges
recentItems.description:
The Johannesburg High Court is expected to deliver judgment in the trial of Bafana Mahungela - accused of the murder of school teacher Kirsten Kluyts. 

Mahungela has pleaded not guilty to all charges including murder, kidnapping, robbery with aggravating circumstances and attempted rape. 

4-year-old Kluyts was killed during a park run in Sandton.  

She suffered blunt force trauma to the head and strangulation. 

SABC News reporter, Calvin Dludla has more.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: US Open in the business end
recentItems.description:
Soon-to-be world number one Elena Rybakina produced a gritty comeback against Coco Gauff to reach the US Open final, in which she will face Aryna Sabalenka in a blockbuster showdown between the tournament's top two seeds.

Rybakina is guaranteed to end Sabalenka's 99-week reign as world number one and will replace the Belarusian at the top when the rankings are updated on Monday.

To talk all things tennis, we have roped in tennis analyst Bruce Davidson 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: South Africa's legal sector in the spotlight
recentItems.description:
Legal association Advocates for Transformation has issued a statement condemning what it calls "a sustained and escalating campaign of threats and intimidation directed at its National Chairperson, Advocate Myron Dewrance SC and Advocate Sandile Khumalo SC, as well members of Advocate Dewrance's family and friends". 

Many viewers may know Advocate Sandile Khumalo SC as one of the commissioners at the Madlanga Commission of Inqiury.

According the statement, the AFT's preliminary enquiries indicate that the grievance may be linked to disciplinary proceedings against a member of the Johannesburg Society of Advocates, who was charged with serious professional misconduct.

We have invited Advocates for Transformation to the discussion to give them right of reply, but they have not yet responded to our invitation.

For more we speak with Johannesburg Society of Advocates Chair, Advocate Don Mahon in studio.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Delareyville farmer seeks government help
recentItems.description:
A forty-seven-year-old blind farmer from Delareyville in the North West is calling for the government to assist him with farming equipment to continue his farming. 

This comes after the Department of Land Reform provided him with a farm in 2016 near Gysdorp. During the handing over of a farm by the Department of Land Reform they promised to provide him with other resources, including planting equipment, fencing, amongst others, but till today nothing has been done. 

He says, he is a victim of crime in many occasions, whereby some of the cattle donated by the government were stolen due to a lack of fencing on the farm.  

SABC News reporter Zebilon Maine is on the story.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
